recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further FHIR-core work is needed for FHIR-7654; FHIR-7303 carries the canonical same-change decision and was also audited in this run.
issue_request: FHIR-7654 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request for FHIR-core Encounter asking that Encounter.hospitalization.dietPreference become 0..* because a patient may have multiple dietary preferences or restrictions; the Jira resolution identifies it as a duplicate of FHIR-7303.
initial_application: Commit 06c7ab85137432aeaa608312554b0f2f73e0dd7c, "Tracker# 6912, 7303, 7304, 7654 Ballot recon", applied the shared ballot reconciliation by changing the historical Encounter spreadsheet row from 0..1 to 0..* and adding the dairy-free/nut-free example. Later refactoring moved the element to Encounter.dietPreference while fhir.ini retained a mapping from Encounter.hospitalization.dietPreference.
additional_context: FHIR-7303 is the Published/Persuasive duplicate target and explicitly records the approved 0..* resolution. Encounter is active in source/fhir.ini, current source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml defines Encounter.dietPreference with max *, and the requirements text points full nutrition needs to NutritionOrder. Jira neighborhood searches only found FHIR-7303/FHIR-7654, and no relevant Zulip or Confluence evidence was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source change was needed because the current build-scope Encounter source already implements the approved repeatability after the element-path refactor.

related_jiras.note: Canonical duplicate target approving the same Encounter dietary preference 0..* change.
